records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Revenues increased $209.9 million in fiscal 2021 compared to fiscal 2020 due to increased demand for our products.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: The change in revenues in fiscal 2021 was due to increased demand for our IoT products.
